camel_example: aliyun kms GenerateAndExportDataKey --region cn-hangzhou --WrappingKeySpec RSA_2048 --EncryptionContext '{"Example":"Example"}' --PublicKeyBlob '' --KeySpec AES_256 --DryRun false --KeyId '1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-123456780000' --WrappingAlgorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 --NumberOfBytes 32
description_en: Generates a random data key, encrypts it by using a CMK and a public key that you specify, and returns both ciphertexts
description_zh: 随机生成一个数据密钥，通过您指定的主密钥（CMK）和公钥加密后，返回CMK加密数据密钥的密文和公钥加密数据密钥的密文
kebab_example: aliyun kms generate-and-export-data-key --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-123456780000 --key-spec AES_256 --number-of-bytes 32 --encryption-context Example=Example --public-key-blob  --wrapping-key-spec RSA_2048 --wrapping-algorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAndExportDataKey

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.

To access a key in another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the key. The key ARN is in the format of `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
The length of the data key that you want to generate. Valid values:

AES_256: a 256-bit symmetric key.

AES_128: a 128-bit symmetric key.

We recommend that you use the KeySpec or NumberOfBytes parameter to specify the length of a data key. If you do not specify either of the parameters, KMS generates a 256-bit data key. If you specify both parameters, KMS ignores the KeySpec parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定生成的数据密钥的长度，取值：

AES_256：256位的对称密钥。
AES_128：128位的对称密钥。

建议使用KeySpec或者NumberOfBytes来指定数据密钥长度。如果两者都不指定，KMS生成256位的数据密钥；如果两者都被指定，KMS会忽略KeySpec参数
parameters.name: key_spec

parameters.help_en:
The length of the data key that you want to generate.

Valid values: 1 to 1024.

Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh:
指定生成的数据密钥的长度。

取值：1~1024。

单位：字节
parameters.name: number_of_bytes

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. If you specify this parameter, you must specify the same parameter when you call the Decrypt operation or other operations to re-encrypt the data key. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html
parameters.help_zh: key/value对的JSON字符串，如果指定了该参数，则在解密或者使用其他密钥转加密时需要提供同样的参数，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html
parameters.name: encryption_context

parameters.help_en: The public key that is encoded in Base64
parameters.name: public_key_blob

parameters.help_en:
The type of the key specified by PublicKeyBlob. For more information about key types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148147.html.
Valid values:

RSA_2048 EC_SM2
parameters.help_zh:
PublicKeyBlob密钥的类型。密钥类型详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148147.html。  
取值：

RSA_2048
EC_SM2
parameters.name: wrapping_key_spec

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm that is used to encrypt the data key using the public key specified by PublicKeyBlob. For more information about encryption algorithms, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148130.html.
Valid values:

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 SM2PKE
parameters.help_zh:
使用PublicKeyBlob所指定的公钥，加密（Wrap）数据密钥时的加密算法。算法详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148130.html。  
取值：

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1
SM2PKE
parameters.name: wrapping_algorithm

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run feature.

true: enables the feature.

false (default): disables the feature.

The DryRun mode is used to test API calls and verify the permissions on the resources that you have access to and the validity of the request parameters. If you enable the DryRun mode, KMS always returns a failure response and the cause of the failure. The following failure causes are included:

DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter is not specified.

ValidationError: The parameters specified in the request are invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
